intro: Duthorian Rall is a respected human knight of the Silver Hand stationed within Stormwind's Cathedral of Light. Renowned as one of the most influential paladins in the Alliance, he oversees the training and spiritual trials of emerging holy warriors. He guides recruits through solemn vows of charity, valor, and devotion to defend Azeroth against the Scourge and lurking domestic threats.

sections.t: A Pillar of the Silver Hand
p: Standing within the vaulted transept of the Cathedral of Light, Duthorian Rall represents the venerable traditions of the Knights of the Silver Hand. With the kingdom unsettled by internal strife and the missing King Varian Wrynn, Duthorian shoulders the vital duty of instilling righteous discipline in fresh initiates. Respected paladins in the field, including Brother Wilhelm in Goldshire and Brandur Ironhammer in Ironforge, direct promising recruits to his guidance to begin their sacred trials.

Duthorian teaches that martial power without moral foundation is hollow. Through the Tome of Divinity, he tests a paladin's capacity for empathy, requiring acts of mercy and selfless service across Stormwind before entrusting them with deeper mysteries. His trials culminate in testing candidates with the Symbol of Life near Heroes' Vigil, sending them to aid wounded allies and teach them to channel the Light's miraculous power to restore fallen comrades from death.
